Property consultant, real-estate SEO writer, and daily content for a real-estate news brand.

letter: I started in civil engineering and property consulting, then moved into real-estate SEO and content, and now run paid social and daily publishing for a real-estate news brand.
My strongest proof for this role is the daily work: planning campaigns, briefing designers and media buyers, working with an agency, and reporting on what works.
Horizon is looking for someone who understands real estate and can coordinate people and campaigns. I know how buyers decide and how developers' sales teams work.
I would like to join the team, support your campaigns and events, and grow with the company.
